rounds.notes:
Round 1 – $3,000

Power: [Shield Stampede](item_0c4ef690-6472-48fe-9257-864c4381f584)

Items: [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da)

Notes: Nothing critical. Play how you like; I prefer survivability to absorb early poke.

Round 2 – $6,750

Items: [Crusader’s Cure](item_e89b853c-2441-432b-b4eb-20bc4b1b0619)

Notes: Crusader’s Cure is essential vs Ana anti-nade and Brig stuns. Combined with Stampede, this starts showing the anti-anti direction: cleanse + engage. Keep in mind I usually get anywhere from 15-17k after first round so I have a lot of extra money, if you do to you can pack it into survivability or into ability power such as [Boost Recycler](item_97a47dab-4554-4340-a9ef-f9424210e08b) it's worth noting that if they do have a [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768) you can always grab [Ironclad Cleats](item_afb5c28e-3980-4a7d-85be-785c32217c28)

If they do NOT have an [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000) or an [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54) take [Ironclad Cleats](item_afb5c28e-3980-4a7d-85be-785c32217c28) instead to face off against the [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a) or [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768). This also helps with [Zenyatta](hero_3c4002ee-e694-48ed-9730-70fd48773317) kicks.

You can grab a combination of these items depending on matchup. For example if they have [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000) and [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a) then take [Crusader’s Cure](item_e89b853c-2441-432b-b4eb-20bc4b1b0619) and [Ironclad Cleats](item_afb5c28e-3980-4a7d-85be-785c32217c28). This helps with [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a) knockback and makes pinning way easier. If they are running say [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a) with a [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768) or [Zenyatta](hero_3c4002ee-e694-48ed-9730-70fd48773317) then [Crusader’s Cure](item_e89b853c-2441-432b-b4eb-20bc4b1b0619) isn't really helpful here unless they have a [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1), so instead focus on [Ironclad Cleats](item_afb5c28e-3980-4a7d-85be-785c32217c28) along with [Boost Recycler](item_97a47dab-4554-4340-a9ef-f9424210e08b) to get the best out of your Charge.

round_upgrades.notes: If they have an Ana goes this! Works for cleansing Ashe's fire too. If they do have an Ashe make sure to grab Ironclad aswell.
Depending on how the matchup is grab a combination of either Crusader's Cure and Boost Recycler or Vise-Versa.

rounds.notes:
Round 3 – $16,750

Powers: [Vroom Boom Boom](item_b016a02c-50bd-4010-91bb-661c1101ade7) or [Vanguard](item_228cf103-0be8-4f1c-8780-f3a8d8676abf) if you want to support your team more.

Items: [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7)

Notes: [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) is Rein’s best epic in tank builds in my opinion. This round gives you a big survivability spike while adding flexible engage power. I want to say after some testing you ***can*** rush [Gryphon Glider](item_9dbd1ba2-b555-450a-8a62-5e33b45c8df6) this round instead of going for [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7). Personally I don't like the ability of running around the map with [Gryphon Glider](item_9dbd1ba2-b555-450a-8a62-5e33b45c8df6) but feeling like a paperweight tank.

round_upgrades.notes: This is for the aggressive Rein, if you want to pivot onto a more AP focused build go this route!
This is for the laid-back, hold my beer Rein, if you want to support your team more than be an actual Rein main this is the go too!
If they have an Ana goes this! Works for cleansing Ashe's fire too. If they do have an Ashe make sure to grab Ironclad aswell.

rounds.notes:
Items: [Gryphon Glider](item_9dbd1ba2-b555-450a-8a62-5e33b45c8df6)

Notes: This is the core round. Glider unlocks the ability to retake high ground, escape messy fights or literately chase a Phara or Mercy in the sky. If you have the extra cash dumping it into [Overclocked Barrier](item_e82af99e-3116-4867-b8a4-52c7dfd1d7e9) is a good choice for more shield sustain. 

***WARNING*** - I want to state that you must really understand the maps, your positioning and where your team is at. If you have an [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000) as a support but use this to kill the enemy backline chances are you will not be getting healed especially if its a lower ranked healer, or you don't position correctly for her. 

**UPDATE:** To be honest [Overclocked Barrier](item_e82af99e-3116-4867-b8a4-52c7dfd1d7e9) hasn't been doing much for me in terms of shield strength. [Pharah](hero_0baf7420-ff13-4b92-81f7-ca21b61dacf9), [Freja](hero_e80840a1-845d-4008-966c-585b7cb4a424), and [Zenyatta](hero_3c4002ee-e694-48ed-9730-70fd48773317) just burst down the shield regardless of what you do to it. So instead of making it mandatory I'm going to change it towards a flex ability this round. I found dumping into early [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) seems to be the best answer right now.

round_upgrades.notes: We didnt use a lot of money in the first 3 rounds so you should have plenty by 4 to get both the epic and the blue for more shield sustain
If they have an Ana goes this! Works for cleansing Ashe's fire too. If they do have an Ashe make sure to grab Ironclad aswell.

Round 5 – $42,750

Powers: [To Me, My Friends!](item_9bd5bb9d-8026-4092-80c5-21e726c0969f)

Items: [Catalytic Crystal](item_3e3f4f77-cdf8-4dda-a5b0-2fb9390aefc4)

Notes: Transition into ult economy abuse. Crystal + TM,MF! = near-constant ult uptime, with [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) scaling as well. If you have the cash you can opt into more [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) either with [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) or a blue of your choice. You can also dump it into survival but just beware that you wont be killing like usual.

Round 6 – $48,750

Items: [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643)

Notes: Flux makes this a balanced kit. Drop lesser survivability items for stronger epics. At this point you feel unkillable vs poke comps but beware Phara still burst you down easily. [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) could also be substituted earlier on if you feel you need more survivability over using [Gryphon Glider](item_9dbd1ba2-b555-450a-8a62-5e33b45c8df6)
